# SiNiSistar 2 "All Abnormal States" Mod

> **📦 Download**: [Latest release](https://github.com/1579486875/SiNiSistar2-AllAbnormalMod/releases/latest) — extract the archive and run `install.bat`; the installer will automatically locate the game directory.

A runtime mod for SiNiSistar 2 that turns all of the game's abnormal states (70 in total) into a floating panel where each one can be **freely toggled on or off and its level freely adjusted**.
It does not modify any game files; everything is done through the game's public interfaces.

**Authors**: 大赢经直插白皮赢道 & 汐蓝 | **License**: [MIT](https://github.com/1579486875/SiNiSistar2-AllAbnormalMod/blob/HEAD/LICENSE)

---

## What is this

- **No need to clear the game to unlock the encyclopedia** — the panel is a separate floating window; press `Home` or `Delete` in the game to open it
- It also appears automatically when you open the encyclopedia's "Character Abnormal State Settings", alongside the game's 4 official toggles
- State names automatically follow the game's language (Simplified Chinese shows Chinese names; names change with the level)
- Enabled states are highlighted in real time (green = enabled, gold = currently selected row)
- The panel can be dragged to any position on screen
- When open, only the roughly 20 rows visible on screen are refreshed; when closed, overhead is nearly zero

## Controls

The panel does not read the game's own input actions and does not use the arrow keys or `Enter`. In the game, these are the menu navigation and dialogue advance keys, respectively. The panel leaves them alone, so operating the panel will not accidentally trigger the game's native interface.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Home` / `Delete` | Toggle the panel (either key works) |
| `Backspace` | Close the panel (has no effect when the panel is not open) |
| `W` / `S` | Select a state up or down |
| `A` / `D` | Adjust severity (hold to repeat) |
| `-` / `+` | Same as above; works on both the main keyboard and the numeric keypad |
| `PageUp` / `PageDown` | Page through the list by one screen |
| `End` | Jump to the end of the list |
| Mouse wheel | Scroll the list (3 rows per notch; the mouse must be over the panel) |
| Left / right mouse button | Click to toggle that row's state and set it as the currently selected row |
| Hold left button and drag on the panel's top or border | Move the panel |

**About dragging**: you can drag the panel from any area where clicking has no function. This includes the top information area (the title / count / hint bar) and the surrounding border. Clicking in the list area is not affected at all.

G1en-114/strata.description: Strata — autoregressive layered 2D-Gaussian painter with a deployment, quantization and kernel toolchain
G1en-114/strata.body:
# Strata: a generative model that paints stroke by stroke, plus its deployment, quantization and kernel toolchain

The model does not output pixels directly. In the order of semantic layers, it outputs one **generalized Gaussian stroke** at a time (position, size, angle, edge hardness, color, opacity) and **Bézier lines** (since v3, used for hair strands and outlines). The strokes stack up to form the painting. The whole pipeline is built from scratch: data production → training and reinforcement learning → evaluation → ONNX export → C++ inference runtime → quantization → GPU kernels.
The focus of this project is **deployment and high-performance computing**: each optimization first profiles the bottleneck, then changes the code, then proves the result is unchanged, and finally measures speed.

## At a glance

| Area | What was done | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Model | Two-stage Transformer (backbone + attribute decoder) + canvas feedback, base 129M / small 20M | Semantic layering protocol; supports local repainting and continuation |
| Export | 6 ONNX graphs + a fixed-shape single-step graph, fusing RoPE and attention | Max error vs. PyTorch ≤ 1.2e-5; ORT and PyTorch sampling **1600/1600 records fully identical** |
| C++ runtime | ONNX Runtime + CUDA Graph + in-place-updated KV cache + per-graph placement on CPU / GPU | small model, B=8: **735 → 1010 records/s (+37%)**, generated output identical record by record |
| GPU bottleneck optimization (base model) | Profiling found that each record serially calls the output heads about 10 times; sampling for 9 attributes (guidance, top-p, fixed slots) fused into one graph | Token-for-token identical to the reference sampler; +17–30% on GPU, plus FP16: B=32 **340 → 586 records/s (1.7×)** |
| Local service | C++ inference service `strata`: OpenAI-compatible API, streaming stroke-by-stroke output, request batching, continuation, painting from a reference image | `./serve.sh` starts with one command; open it in a browser and use it |
| Quantization (base model) | FP16 / dynamic INT8 / weight-only INT8 / weight-only INT4, two-level acceptance | **GPU: choose FP16**: B=32 at 529 records/s (+40%), top-1 agreement 98.6%; **CPU: choose dynamic INT8**: B=1 at 64 vs 29 records/s (+121%) |
| GPU kernels | Hand-written Triton tile rasterizer (forward + backward) | **64×** faster than the PyTorch dense implementation (RTX 5070) |
| Cross-platform | Same CUDA source ported to Hygon DCU via hipify | See `docs/hip_port_log.md` |

# LightBoard (轻白板)

A full-screen whiteboard built on .NET 11 and WPF, for classroom writing and courseware annotation.

- Ready to use out of the box
- Designed around classroom needs, validated in real classrooms, and continuously improved based on classroom feedback
- Extreme performance, suitable for low-end devices
- Can replace Seewo Whiteboard / Seewo Light Whiteboard / Honghe Whiteboard (鸿合白板)

## Performance

- Test machine: Seewo large display, Windows 10, 6th-gen i7
    - Startup time < 0.5s
    - Zooming and dragging easily saturate the screen's 30 Hz frame rate
    - Drawing pipeline latency < 30ms
    - Erasing pipeline latency < 40ms

## Features

### Writing

- Pen with 8 colors and 5 thickness levels, plus a yellow highlighter, straight lines, and circles
- Eraser erases by area; pressing down with four or five fingers together performs a palm erase; when the device reports contact size, a palm pressed on the screen erases directly by contact area
- After selection, items can be moved, scaled, rotated, cloned, or pasted; dragging on blank space defaults to lasso selection, which can be changed to diagonal rectangle selection in Settings
- Undo and redo, 200 steps by default, adjustable in Settings
- Eraser, highlighter, and selection can be set in Settings to automatically return to the pen after a specified number of uses; the remaining count can be shown on the eraser ring
- Multiple people can write at once: multiple fingers whose contact spacing exceeds a threshold each form their own pen
- Stylus support: stroke width changes with device pressure, pen-inversion erasing, barrel button for temporary erasing, and hover shows the pen tip; arbitrated against touch and mouse by priority
- Canvas automatically expands on all four edges
- When there is ink inside an edge hot zone, an arrow button appears on that side; clicking it pans the canvas until the hot zone is free of ink

### Pages and Documents

- Multi-page whiteboard: previous / next page; pressing New on the last page creates a new one; clicking the page number expands a page list with thumbnails
- Each page independently retains its zoom, offset, and undo history
- Page backgrounds support PowerPoint, Word, PDF, XPS, and images
- Backgrounds are recorded by source and reloaded when a file is opened; references are kept when the source file is missing
- The File menu can set the current page's background to an image or clear it
- Documents, images, pages from `.lbf` files, or `.isf` ink can be attached to the current board

### Files

- `.lbf`: saves ink and background references for each page
- `.isf`: Windows Ink files, which can be opened or attached
- Every minute, the entire board is backed up to `recover` in the program directory; "Open Last Backup" in the File menu opens the most recent one
- On close, if there is unsaved content, you can choose quick save or pick another path
- Single instance: when launched again, the request is handed to the already-running window

### Export

- PNG: all pages exported, named by page number, with optional 25%, 50%, and 100% scaling
- PDF: the whole board exported as a single file, with the same scaling options
- SVG: all pages exported, named by page number; ink is saved as vector paths, and page backgrounds are embedded as PNG
- Export shows progress and the current page number

Native macOS menu bar translation tool: multilingual hover word lookup, local OCR, selection translation, and in-place translation preview and replacement within input fields.

Native macOS hover and selection translator built with SwiftUI, AppKit, Vision, Accessibility and Apple Translation. Text and image recognition run locally; no third-party translation API or API key is required.

> Currently v0.6.4 preview. Compatibility for cross-app word lookup, input-field replacement, and undo still needs to be verified app by app.

## Features

- **Hover translation**　After resting the mouse over foreign-language text, a line of translation appears below the original. It hides when the mouse moves away.
- Japanese and Korean support single-character buttons and mixed English brand names. For pure-kanji Japanese menus, you can enable “Translate pure kanji as Japanese” in Preferences.
- **Selection quick orbs**　After dragging or double-clicking text in any app, three small round buttons (“Translate / Copy / Save”) appear beside it. Automatically adapts to native apps, Chrome / Arc, Electron editors, PDFs, and terminals.
- **Built-in clippings + local Markdown sync**　Clicking “Save” on a selection or translation card bookmarks the original and translation. RobbsLuo/Coding2API.body:
# Coding2API

Wraps eleven channels (**CodeBuddy** domestic and international, as two separate channels, **TRAE SOLO**, **OpenCode Zen**, **Kilo**, **Qoder**, **CodeArts**, **OfficeAce**, **小浣熊**, **灵犀**, **超级麦吉**), plus an optional **generic OpenAI-compatible upstream**, into a single OpenAI-compatible API: a shared credential pool, unified model names and scheduling, and per-user usage statistics.

> **Warning**
>
> Reverse-engineered interfaces, for study and research only. No security audit has been performed. Public deployment requires a reverse proxy, authentication, and an IP allowlist.

## Features

- **Multi-protocol endpoints**: `/v1/chat/completions` (streaming and non-streaming), `/v1/responses` (Codex CLI), `/v1/messages` (Claude Code), `/v1beta/models/{m}:generateContent` (Gemini SDK), `/v1/models`, `/v1/user/balance`, and built-in retrieval at `/v1/tools/search` and `/v1/fetch`.
- **Unified scheduling**: flat model names pick a credential by health; `模型@渠道` (`model@channel`) forces a specific channel. Priority order: free channels, then fewest in-flight requests, then expiring quota, then health with tiered cooldown, then highest balance. Credential **weight** (`-1000..1000`) only reorders within the same health tier. The x0 multiplier in the catalog is calibrated against actual charges measured over the last 24h. Model-level rate limits only steer traffic away from that model. Multi-turn conversations stick to the same credential and rotate only on error.
- **Expiring quota first**: the primary window (default 36h) spends quota that is about to expire first. On a tie, the 7-day window is compared. Units are unified as credits.
- **Model lists loaded per credential**: only channels with usable credentials are listed, so there are no phantom models. The catalog is written to disk and is ready on restart.
- **Shared credential pool**: maintained by admins and shared by all users, with credentials encrypted at rest using `APP_SECRET`. Supports device-code and OAuth login, multi-account switching, quota probing, check-ins, and token pre-refresh.
- **Three roles**: `admin`, `operator`, and `viewer` (SQLite). Supports one-time activation links and a forced password change on first login. Changing a role or disabling an account revokes sessions immediately. Logins and write operations are audited.
- **Growth center** (CodeBuddy only): claim gifts, dispatch Buddy, claim task rewards, backfill missed logins, redeem login streaks, and open blind boxes. `GROWTH_IRREVERSIBLE_ACTIONS=false` disables irreversible actions. Enterprise accounts are skipped automatically.
- **Privacy-scrubbed statistics**: conversation content is not stored. Detailed records are kept for 90 days, and hourly summaries are kept permanently. Usage is visualized by user, channel, model, and credential. Costs are estimated from OpenRouter list prices. Details are streamed over SSE.
- **Monthly billing** (`operator` and above): monthly summaries of requests, tokens, and costs by user and by key, exportable as CSV / JSONL…

## Project Introduction

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) by default uses the directory where a newly created workspace is located as the agent's primary directory. In the default workspace read-write mode (`workspace-write`), the sandbox's read and write scope also covers only that one directory. This plugin extends DSH's workspace scope to "one primary directory plus multiple additional directories."

Not all projects are monorepos. A development project often consists of several independent Git repositories, and working across them used to mean repeatedly switching sessions. Similar tools have long supported adding multiple folders to one workspace. This plugin brings the same capability to DSH: register other repositories as additional roots and set each one to read-only, read-write, or to follow the session's current permissions as needed. The agent can then read and write within the authorized scope.

# ProxyEverything

An experimental general-purpose web reverse proxy based on Cloudflare Workers.

## Try

1. Deploy `worker.js` as an ES Module to Cloudflare Workers, using a relatively recent compatibility date (`2026-04-23` or later is recommended).
2. Configure `ALLOWED_TARGET_ORIGINS` in the Worker's variables, for example `https://example.com,https://static.example.com`. The list matches exact origins (protocol, host, and port). Redirect targets and resource domains that need to be proxied must also be included. If it is not configured, left empty, or invalid, the Worker will not fetch from the origin.
3. Use a dedicated HTTPS-only domain. It is recommended to restrict access through Cloudflare Access or similar facilities and configure rate limiting, then visit the deployment domain. Do not use cache rules to force caching of requests that carry credentials.

Newly generated `/~…` links preserve the percent-encoding in the target path. Older links that encode each segment separately, or encode the entire address, remain accessible. If the upstream signs the original URL, confirm that the URL normalization rules of the deployment domain do not alter these escapes.

**Do not treat this project as an isolated browser or a public proxy.** Sites on the list share the proxy origin in the browser, so they can access each other's same-origin pages and browser storage. Cookie name rewriting is only for compatibility and does not provide security isolation. Only allow mutually trusted targets, do not handle sensitive logins or data, and do not share an origin with other applications. To rewrite content, the proxy removes some upstream restrictions such as CSP and SRI, so you cannot rely on the original site's browser isolation policies. WebSockets without a reliable Referer do not have a forged target Origin, so upstreams that require a specific Origin may reject the handshake. This list does not check IPs after DNS resolution, and it cannot replace outbound network controls in the deployment environment.

The cookie namespace keeps `__Secure-`, `__Host-`, `__Http-`, and `__Host-Http-` at the start of names, and validates the corresponding attributes before rewriting. `SameSite=None` and `Partitioned` must also carry the `Secure` attribute that the origin or script originally declared; the proxy will not add this attribute. Cookies from older versions that hid these prefixes are no longer read. After upgrading, you may need to clear cookies on the dedicated proxy domain and log in again. The naming format for ordinary cookies is unchanged.

muyuanjin/dsh-ptc-plus.body:
**Let the model keep computing and revise directly within the same session, reducing repeated work and avoidable tool-call errors.**

PTC Plus provides a stateful TypeScript compute environment for DSH's **PTC mode**. Built on a REPL, it lets variables, functions, imports, and intermediate results be reused across tool calls. To support models that continuously write and modify code, the extension declares update rules and provides module syntax adaptation, call fault tolerance, and code editing capabilities.

- **Keep computing:** Data that has been read and organized stays in the session, so the next call continues directly from it.
- **Edit in place:** Revise a variable or function of the same name, and existing closures read the updated bindings; small changes can send only a code diff.
- **Fewer call errors:** Adapts common module syntax, handles accurately identifiable call omissions, and provides fix suggestions for verifiable syntax errors.
- **Reuse common capabilities:** Save frequently used functions as global bindings, provide interfaces and usage hints to the model, and use them across multiple sessions.

[Quick Start](#快速开始) · [Feature Overview](#功能概览) · [Continuous Computation and Language Extensions](#连续计算与语言扩展) · [Code Editing and Call Fault Tolerance](#代码编辑与调用容错) · [Global Bindings](#全局绑定跨会话复用常用函数) · [Interface and Settings](#界面与设置) · [State and Recovery](#值传递与状态恢复) · [Development](#开发)

## Quick Start

Requires the latest available official DSH. Node.js must satisfy both the plugin's `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and the requirements of the selected DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ptc-plus
```

Replace `<profile>` with the actual profile name, restart DSH, and select **PTC mode** in the session. Continuous computation, call fault tolerance, and global bindings are enabled by default. To upgrade, run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ptc-plus@latest` and then restart the host. For other installation methods, Desktop, local development launchers, and troubleshooting, see the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/muyuanjin/dsh-ptc-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/installation.md).

The plugin declares a DSH compatibility range of `>=0.2.1-0 <0.2.3`, and the host runs a version pre-check. Interface adaptation within this range is still verified through public capability checks and packaging tests.

The official npm releases `0.2.2-rc.5` and `0.2.3-alpha.2` have both passed packaging contract and session lifecycle verification. For the host's Node.js requirements, see the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/muyuanjin/dsh-ptc-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/installation.md).

nianqianha/WeReadDownloader.body:
# WeReadDownloader

Export books from WeChat Reading as EPUB. Body text is fetched chapter by chapter and downloads can resume from where they stopped. Highlights stay in the body text, while comments and thoughts are collected into an appendix at the end of the book in the style you choose. You can queue multiple books for download at once.

A Windows desktop program with a Tk graphical interface. The download engine is a separate worker process.

> The copyright of exported content belongs to the original authors and publishers. Please use it only for your own reading. See the [Disclaimer](#免责声明).

---

## Features

- **Search and download**: Search by book title or author. After you select a book, the first chapter is fetched first to confirm the body text can actually be retrieved, and then the full book download begins.
- **Bookshelf download**: Lists the books in your WeChat Reading account directly. Click one to download it.
- **Resumable downloads**: Chapters, images, and highlight data are written to disk chapter by chapter. If a download is interrupted, resuming does not start over from the beginning.
- **Queued downloads**: Check multiple books to add them to the queue. They download automatically in order. You can pause after the current book, skip a book, and at the end get a summary of unfinished books.
- **Four annotation modes**: comments and thoughts / comments only / thoughts only / body text only.
- **Highlight toggle**: The "Highlights" checkbox on the download card controls whether highlight marks are drawn in the body text. Turning it off does not affect whether comments and thoughts are included.
- **Translations of foreign-language books**: Books that have WeChat Reading's built-in machine translation can be shown as **bilingual** (original plus translation), translation only, or original only. Bilingual is the default, and switching modes does not require downloading again.
- **Unified appendix**: Comments and thoughts are collected into an appendix volume at the end of the book. The body text keeps only clickable superscript markers.
- **Missing-item notes**: What the book is missing (missing images, highlights that could not be located) is recorded in `manifest.json` and also reported when the download finishes.
- **Size control**: Illustrations are deduplicated by content. Images and body text share one compressed archive, so the same book is not stored twice.
- **HD covers**: The finished cover uses the HD variant from the WeChat Reading CDN (428×616). It falls back to the thumbnail only if the HD variant cannot be retrieved.
- **Easy to find when done**: In Settings you can check "Reveal the finished EPUB in Explorer after the download completes."
